name: MRAMG-Bench
description: A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multimodal retrieval-augmented multimodal generation tasks, featuring 4,800 QA pairs across six datasets and three domains, with human annotations and diverse difficulty levels.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark from the multimodal retrieval-augmented generation literature, but not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes 4,346 documents and 14,190 images; covers Web, Academia, and Lifestyle domains; provides evaluation results for 11 generative models.
